sections.title: Reading — Task 1: Tasks
sections.instructions: Read the passage, then answer the questions.

questions.prompt: The chart below gives information about the UK's ageing population in 1985 and makes predictions for 2035. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

Some people believe that a great difference in age between parents and children is more beneficial. Do you think the advantages of a greater difference in age between them outweigh the disadvantages? Write at least 250 words. Cambridge IELTS Tests 1 to 17
